area: State Route 58 near MLK Boulevard, eastbound
summary: A traffic stop on SR-58 turned into a medical emergency when a family member in the stopped vehicle needed medical aid. Units cleared the scene.

summary: Dispatchers handled a welfare check involving a Regional Center client who expressed suicidal thoughts but had no access to medication. Units cleared the call.

area: 5500 block of Silver Crossing Street, south Bakersfield
disposition: both occupants out of the vehicle; crews on scene
summary: A vehicle crashed into a wall in the 5500 block of Silver Crossing Street just after midnight, drawing a full fire assignment alongside Bakersfield police. Both occupants were out of the vehicle when crews arrived.
_src: Rescue response, station 14's area, engine 14, engine 9, truck 15, battalion 2, 5500 Silver Crossing Street for a vehicle into a wall, BPD en route

summary: Officers responded to an alley off North Chester Avenue near Washington Avenue after a report that two men were beating a victim on the ground, one of them holding an unknown object.
_src: The second subject was in possession of an unknown object hitting the victim while on the ground at Northchester, Washington.

summary: Firefighters were sent to Brentwood Drive for a medical aid call involving a person reported possibly unconscious.

summary: Deputies responded to a White Lane home after a caller reported a person entering through the roof. A second subject in a ski mask was also described, and crews requested a ladder while a K9 was sought, though one was not available.
_src: 2501 White Lane, DG requesting assistance with the ladder ... black or Hispanic male, black ski mask

summary: Officers responded to Buena Vista Boulevard after a report of a man under the influence knocking on doors and walking near nearby residences; a suspect was detained.
